Reg. 53/2010, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — B. BAILEY,Minister of Finance; S. MALCOLMSON,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 1 of the Education and Health Sector Organizations Regulation, B.C. minutes_briefs.title: B.C. removes two organizations from education and health sector regulation
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has amended the Education and Health Sector Organizations Regulation, which lists certain organizations that must follow special budget transparency rules. The amendment removes two organizations from that list, meaning they are no longer subject to these specific reporting and accountability requirements. The change was made official on June 5, 2026, and published on June 16, 2026.
